interview.secured: Per the home screen, 'Secured' means every task for today is done, so the day counts toward your streak.
interview.freeze: The app never explained a freeze to me in anything I saw, so I can't say what it is.
interview.selfReported: The app didn't spell it out, but it appears to mean I marked the task done myself, such as Read, with no verification or proof beyond my word.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - My streak is only at 1 day and I like the simple daily check-in, but I mainly came back to see if Blake joined and the app left some terms unexplained.

goals.text: Find Blake's post in the feed or on your challenge. Like it and leave a one-line comment. Then open Blake's profile.
